messages.subject: Letter before Action — Brightwater Analytics v Caldervale Underwriting
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Sirs,

We act for Brightwater Analytics Limited. Please find attached our Letter before Action concerning your purported termination of the Polaris Agreement and the unpaid Milestone 2 fee. We accept your repudiation of the Agreement.

Please acknowledge within 14 days and respond in full within 30 days.

Yours faithfully,
Whitfield Carter LLP

Tom Gallagher
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
+44 (0)20 7946 1100
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.plaintextBody:
Mr Gallagher,

Receipt acknowledged. We have passed your letter to our solicitors, Birchall Stone LLP, who will respond. We do not accept that any sum is due; the platform repeatedly failed to meet the availability levels we were promised.

Gerald Maddox
Chief Operating Officer, Caldervale Underwriting Limited
